{{Quote|We are under attack by Imperial Star Destroyers! Begin evasive maneuvers. Launch the X-Wing fighters.|Admiral Gial Ackbar, commanding the Rebel fleet|audio=AckbarTurkana-XW.flac|<ref name="XW" />}}
The '''Battle of Turkana''' was a conflict in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. A [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Xamuel Lennox]] was dispatched to investigate reports of a Rebel [[Task force/Legends|task force]] massing above the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Turkana/Legends|Turkana]]. After confirming the Rebel presence, Lennox launched [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] to target the Rebel [[Warship/Legends|warships]]. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], commanding the Rebel fleet from aboard the [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]] ''[[Independence]]'' responded by launching [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] and [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] squadrons to intercept.

The Alliance had only recently acquired the X-wing after members of the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] design team defected upon learning that the Empire planned to [[Imperialization/Legends|nationalize]] the company. The presence of the advanced new [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] took the Imperial forces by surprise. The X-wings overwhelmed the Imperial fighters before launching their [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] at the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] fleet, causing severe damage to two [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. Lennox issued the order to retreat, leaving several Rebel [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] damaged but none destroyed.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Sir, our TIE Interceptors have located a Rebel Fleet orbiting the planet Turkana.|An [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] reports to Captain Xamuel Lennox before the battle|audio=SirOurTIEs-XW.flac|<ref name="XW" />}}
After the [[Corellian Treaty|founding]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], the fledgling Rebellion had begun growing its [[Alliance Military/Legends|military forces]] for their [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. While the support of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] gave the Alliance access to top-of-the-line [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]],<ref name="NEC" /> they had to make use of older, easily obtainable [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] such as the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing]] and [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]].<ref name="TSC">{{StoryCite|story=The Stele Chronicles|book=Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)}}</ref> This changed in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] when [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] learned that the Empire planned to [[Imperialization/Legends|nationalize]] the company in an attempt to prevent production of their new advanced starfighter, the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing]]. Many of Incom's design team defected to the Alliance, taking the plans and prototypes for the X-wing with them and wiping the data from the company's [[Computer/Legends|computers]]. With help from governments sympathetic to the Rebellion, the Alliance set about producing X-wings in sufficient numbers and rolling them out to the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|fleet]].<ref name="TEGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

[[File:Turkana.png|thumb|left|250px|The Rebel fleet in orbit of Turkana]]
Shortly after acquiring the X-wing, the Rebels were secretly massing their forces in orbit of [[Turkana/Legends|Turkana]],<ref name="XW" /> a lightly populated [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="IH:ACG" /> in the [[Pakuuni sector/Legends|Pakuuni sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> The [[Task force/Legends|task force]], under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] aboard the [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]] ''[[Independence]]'', consisted of a total of seven [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]], two [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates]], two [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]], four [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transports]] and one [[Golan Ribbon tanker/Legends|Golan Ribbon tanker]] capable of refueling the other [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. The [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was equipped with both Y-wings and the new X-wing starfighter.<ref name="IH:ACG" />

[[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] learned of the presence of the [[Warship/Legends|warships]], with initial estimates placing the Rebel strength between four to six capital ships, along with three to eight support vessels. In response, the Imperial [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] dispatched a fleet of ten [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Xamuel Lennox]] to Turkana with orders to locate and eradicate the Rebel forces. With Lennox's [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Rebel Dream|''Tyrant'']] serving as [[Command ship/Legends|lead vessel]], primary support was provided by the [[Emancipator|''Accuser'']], under the command of Captain [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]].<ref name="IH:ACG" />

==The battle==
===Imperial assault===
{{Quote|Move our Star Destroyers within range and launch all TIE Fighter Squadrons.|Captain Lennox during the Battle of Turkana|audio=LennoxTurkana-XW.flac|<ref name="XW" />}}
[[File:TurkanaImpStar-XW.png|thumb|right|250px|A Star Destroyer launches TIE fighters above Turkana]]
After a patrol of [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptors]] pinpointed the Rebel fleet's location, Lennox gave the order to attack,<ref name="XW" /> bringing his task force out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and using [[Formation Besh]], [[Attack Pattern Tartarus]] to ensure the Rebels could not escape the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Having caught the Rebel forces unprepared, the Star Destroyers moved to engage the Rebel cruisers with long-range [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] while Lennox ordered the ''Tyrant'', ''Accuser'' and ''[[Flanchard]]'' to launch their [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Fighter wing/Legends|wings]]. The [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bomber]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] were dispatched to target the [[Engine/Legends|engines]] of the enemy ships, while the TIE interceptors and [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] were tasked with providing cover for the bombers by [[Starfighter combat/Legends|targeting]] any Rebel fighters that came their way.<ref name="IH:ACG" />

Ackbar was quick to respond to the threat<ref name="IH:ACG" /> and his knowledge of Imperial tactics, gained while previously [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the Empire's [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], proved crucial.<ref name="NEGC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> The admiral instructed the Rebel fleet to take evasive maneuvers and ordered the new X-wing fighters to be deployed.<ref name="XW" /> Less than a minute after the battle began, three squadrons of Y-wings and,<ref name="IH:ACG" /> to the surprise of the Imperials,<ref name="XW" /> two squadrons of X-wings launched, including [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] from aboard the ''Independence''.<ref name="IH:ACG" />

===Rebel retaliation===
{{Quote|Red Squadron was piloting twelve of those X-wings, stationed aboard Ackbar's ship ''Independence''. I notched three kills before I had to eject.|Wedge Antilles|<ref name="IH:ACG" />}}
[[File:RedSquadronTurkana-XW.png|thumb|left|250px|Red Squadron launch from the ''Independence'']]
Although Piett alerted Lennox to the X-Wing's capabilities, Lennox dismissed Piett's warning and did not modify his tactics, believing that the Empire's superior numbers would win out in the end. Ultimately, however, the X-wings proved a match for the TIE fighters and interceptors, with similar maneuverability and speed.<ref name="IH:ACG" /> The X-wings' [[Deflector shield/Legends|onboard shields]] also allowed them to absorb [[Laser cannon/Legends|weapons fire]] without damage;<ref name="IH:ACG" /> an ability lacked by the Imperial fighters.<ref name="TSC" /> Although the Rebel fighters suffered some losses, they inflicted far more damage on the TIE squadrons. Among the [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]] involved in the battle was [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] of Red Squadron, who managed to land three kills before he was forced to [[Ejector seat/Legends|eject]] from his X-wing.<ref name="IH:ACG" />

With the TIE fighters and interceptors occupied fighting the X-wings, the Rebel Y-wings were able to evade the Imperial fighters and pick apart the TIE bombers. Piett, realizing that Lennox's failure to adapt had already cost them the battle, directed the ''Accuser'' towards the bombers and fired on the attacking Y-wings, destroying many and allowing for a lone TIE bomber squadron to reach one of the MC80 Star Cruisers and deliver its payload, disabling the cruiser's [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drive]].<ref name="IH:ACG" />

As the X-wings, having already wiped out the TIE fighters and interceptors, proceeded to join the Y-wings in targeting the remaining bombers, Piett responded by ordering all Star Destroyers to enter [[Formation Aleph]], [[Attack Pattern Abbadon]], closing to full weapons range. However, with no remaining [[starfighter screen]] to protect the Imperial capital ships, the X-wings fired their [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] at the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] shields of the ''[[Ajax]]'' and [[Formidable/Legends|''Formidable'']], causing serious damage to both Star Destroyers. Having failed to destroy a single Rebel capital ship, despite inflicting damage to several, Lennox was forced to issue the order to retreat and the Imperial forces jumped to hyperspace and regrouped at [[Pakuuni/Legends|Pakuuni]].<ref name="IH:ACG" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Countering fast-attack starfighters is critical for victory.|Captain Firmus Piett|<ref name="IH:ACG" />}}
Following the battle, Piett submitted a mission report in which he blamed the defeat on Lennox's inability to adapt to the threat of the X-wing fighters. Piett's report recommended utilizing the agile TIE interceptor in larger numbers when facing X-wings in battle and the use of [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] to slow down the Rebel fighters, making it easier for [[Imperial gunner/Legends|Imperial gunners]] to acquire a lock on the small targets. Finally, Piett recommended that Lennox be removed from command of [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] forces in the Pakuuni sector.<ref name="IH:ACG" /> Piett later became admiral of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], in which Lennox served as captain of the ''Tyrant''.<ref name="Insider96">{{InsiderCite|96|The Empire's Finest: Who's Who in the Imperial Military}}</ref>

[[File:Independence-Ackbar.png|thumb|right|250px|Ackbar, during the Battle of Turkana]]
Shocked by the Empire's loss at Turkana, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] ordered swift retaliation.<ref name="XW" /> Along with his report, Piett submitted a plan for an Imperial counterattack campaign entitled [[Operation Strike Fear]], which he volunteered to lead.<ref name="IH:ACG" /> Operation Strike Fear was a major offensive which targeted Alliance bases<ref name="CSWE-OSF">{{CSWECite|II|417|Operation Strike Fear}}</ref> in an attempt to spread fear of the Empire and quell further resistance. Starting with the [[Battle of Brigia (Galactic Civil War)|assault]] on [[Brigia/Legends|Brigia]], Operation Strike would torment the Rebellion for some time until the [[Destruction of the Invincible|destruction]] of its command ship, the Star Destroyer [[Invincible (Strike Fear)|''Invincible'']].<ref name="XW" />

Having led the Alliance to its first victory against the Imperial Navy at Turkana, Ackbar went on to become [[Admiral of the Fleet/Legends|commander]] of the Alliance Fleet.<ref name="FF9">{{FactFile2014|9|ACK 1-4|Admiral Ackbar}}</ref> The X-wing became an essential part of the Alliance arsenal, playing a crucial role at their victory over the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The X-wing's success ultimately led the Empire to rethink their reliance on superior numbers and develop more capable starfighters, including the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]].<ref name="NEGVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Turkana was created for the [[1993]] [[Totally Games]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] in which it appeared during the opening cutscene. The battle was not formally named in ''X-Wing''<ref name="XW" /> but was identified as the Battle of Turkana in Admiral Ackbar's biography in the [[2002]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="NEGC" /> The battle was subsequently mentioned in ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' ([[2006]])<ref name="NEC" /> and Ackbar's entry in [[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 9|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 9]] ([[2014]]).<ref name="FF9" /> The most detailed description of the battle to date came in the form of a post-mission report by Captain Piett which appears in Wallace's 2014 reference book ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''.<ref name="IH:ACG" /> Although described as a Rebel victory in ''The New Essential Guide to Characters'',<ref name="NEGC" /> ''The New Essential Chronology''<ref name="NEC" /> and [[The Official Star Wars Fact File (2014)|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'']],<ref name="FF9" /> ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' ([[2009]]) shows the battle as a draw on the map entitled "Flashpoints in the Galactic Civil War." The same map misspells Turkana as "Turkhana."<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:Star_Wars_X-wing_Cabbel_and_Xamuel_Lennox.png|thumb|left|250px|Lennox and an officer resembling Cabbel in a shot based on ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]
Originally released on floppy disk in 1993,<ref name="LA20">{{LucasArts|url=20th/history_2.htm|text=20th Anniversary History, Part Two: The Classics, 1990 - 1994}}</ref> ''X-Wing'' was re-released along with its expansion packs in [[1994]] as ''Star Wars: X-Wing Collector's CD-ROM''<ref name="Portfolio">{{WebCite|url=http://www.totallygames.com/games-portfolio-xwing.shtml|text=Portfolio: Star Wars: X-Wing Computer Game Series|archivedate=20130322134849}}</ref> and was later included in the ''[[X-Wing Collector Series]]'' in [[1998]].<ref name="GameSpot">{{GameSpot|url=reviews/x-wing-collector-series-review/1900-2532008|text=X-Wing Collector Series Review|author=Tim McDonald|date=1998-07-15}}</ref> The cutscene depicting the Battle of Turkana changed in each version of the game, with higher quality versions of several scenes. This resulted in some changes to the number of ships shown on each side of the battle. The number of Star Destroyers shown changed from six in the original release to five in the ''Collector's CD-ROM'' and ten in the ''Collector Series''. Likewise the Rebel fleet was originally shown to include six Mon Calamari Star Cruisers, but the ''Collector Series'' version shows seven, along with two Nebulon-B frigates and two CR90 corvettes.<ref name="XW" /> ''Imperial Handbook'' later confirmed the later numbers and established that the Rebel fleet included four GR-75 transports,<ref name="IH:ACG" /> only two of which are seen on screen at the same time in the ''Collector Series'' release. The ''Collector Series'' also significantly increased the number of Imperial fighters shown in the battle.<ref name="XW" />

The ''X-Wing'' cutscene features a shot based on [[:File:Lennox Cabbel.jpg|footage]] from [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], in which Lennox talks to [[Cabbel]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="XW" /><ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> ''Imperial Handbook'' confirmed that Lennox was in command of the Imperial fleet during the battle.<ref name="IH:ACG" /> However, the ''[[Hoth Limited]]'' expansion set of [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] states that Cabbel was a recent graduate from the [[Officer's Candidate School]] at the time of the Battle of Hoth,<ref name="CCG-Cabbel">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Lieutenant Cabbel}}</ref> which took place in [[3 ABY]], more than three years after the Battle of Turkana.<ref name="NEC" />
